review_batches.context: Read the full 353-row battle member and preceding 505-row aftermath. Allies debate Cain's Veil Astin versus Selg's blue mech, arrive/refuse orders in alternatives, then Zigrim enters.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Rest's source-of-trouble suspicion distinct from Selg commander identification and Arthur's alternate target advice. No Trust threshold inferred for refusal branches. Preserve ranks, Code3 recognition, fearlessness observation and incomplete experiment memories. Growster's cannon boast is not a new weapon ID.

review_batches.context: Full member read. Zigrim's Fores orders cooperation while Growster stays belligerent; Rest/Yamato clarify no hostile action including counterattacks. Repeated variants precede Cain confrontation.
review_batches.decisions: Retain every repeated arrival and warning. Do not turn Fores's attack on the other Agarthian force into attack on Rayblade/Rest. Negative-intent ellipsis is read as hostility from the following oppose/crush threat. Cain's data sufficiency is his judgment, not an objective mission result.
